name: leaf_ftR_continuous
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, continuity at the boundary frequencies in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open endpoint leaf. -/
theorem leaf_ftR_continuous (K : ℝ → ℂ) (hK : Integrable K) : Continuous (ftR K) := by
  have hct : Continuous (FourierTransform.fourier K) :=
    VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_continuous Real.continuous_fourierChar
      (L := innerₗ ℝ) continuous_inner hK
  have he : ftR K = FourierTransform.fourier K :=
    funext (Decomp404b.ftR_eq_fourier K)
  rw [he]
  exact hct
twin: The Fourier transform of an integrable complex function on the real line is continuous in frequency.
instance: The nonzero Kfun kernel with Delta 1/8 is integrable by Decomp371d.kernel_instance.
source: P0082 page 356 Fourier support and Poisson display.

name: leaf_rescale_tendsto
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, continuity at the boundary frequencies in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open endpoint leaf. -/
theorem leaf_rescale_tendsto (ξ : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ξ * (1 + (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds ξ) := by
  simpa only [add_zero, mul_one] using
    (tendsto_const_nhds (x := ξ)).mul
      ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).add
        (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)))
twin: For every real xi, the sequence xi times one plus the reciprocal of n plus one tends to xi.
instance: Take xi one. The sequence one plus the reciprocal of n plus one tends to one.
source: P0082 page 356 Fourier support and Poisson display.

name: leaf_rescale_abs_gt_one
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, continuity at the boundary frequencies in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open endpoint leaf. -/
theorem leaf_rescale_abs_gt_one (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : 1 ≤ |ξ|) (n : ℕ) :
    1 < |ξ * (1 + (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))| := by
  have hp : 0 < (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < 1 + (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))]
  nlinarith
twin: If the absolute value of xi is at least one, each of those rescaled frequencies has absolute value strictly greater than one.
instance: Take xi one and n zero. The rescaled frequency is two.
source: P0082 page 356 Fourier support and Poisson display.

name: leaf_eq_zero_of_tendsto
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, continuity at the boundary frequencies in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open endpoint leaf. -/
theorem leaf_eq_zero_of_tendsto {f : ℝ → ℂ} {u : ℕ → ℝ} {ξ : ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) (hu : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds ξ)) (h0 : ∀ n : ℕ, f (u n) = 0) :
    f ξ = 0 := by
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhds (f ξ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, h0] using (hf.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hu)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim tendsto_const_nhds
twin: A continuous complex function that is zero along a sequence tending to xi is zero at xi.
instance: Take f of x equal to the real x as a complex number, xi zero and the sequence constantly zero. This function is not identically zero.
source: P0082 page 356 Fourier support and Poisson display.
